rows.role_title: Президент Российской Федерации — President of the Russian Federation
rows.text: In the address Yeltsin says this is his last address as President of Russia and that today, the last day of the outgoing century, he is resigning, leaving before the end of his term.
rows.locator: Transcript, paragraphs 3-5 ('сегодня я последний раз обращаюсь к вам как Президент России'; 'я ухожу в отставку')

rows.role_title: Исполняющий обязанности Президента Российской Федерации — Acting President of the Russian Federation
rows.text: He says that on resigning he signed, in accordance with the Constitution, a decree placing the duties of the President on the Chairman of the Government, Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin, who will be head of state for three months, with a presidential election to follow in three months.
rows.locator: Transcript, paragraph beginning 'В соответствии с Конституцией, уходя в отставку' (fourth from the end)
